content:
To determine the day of the week for March 31, 2025, start by finding a known weekday in that year.

The year 2024 was a leap year and contained 366 days. January 1, 2024 was a Monday. Because 366 leaves a remainder of 2 when divided by 7, January 1, 2025 is two weekdays later, which is Wednesday.

Next, move through the months of 2025.

January has 31 days. If January 1 is Wednesday, then January 31 is 30 days later. Thirty divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 2, so January 31 is Tuesday plus 2 days, making it Friday.

February in 2025 has 28 days, since 2025 is not a leap year. February 1 is therefore Saturday. Twenty-eight days later is exactly four weeks, so February 28 is the day just before the next Saturday. Counting 27 days after February 1 (or simply noting that February 28 is one day before March 1), March 1, 2025 is a Saturday.

March has 31 days. If March 1 is Saturday, then March 31 is 30 days later. Thirty divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 2, so March 31 is Saturday plus 2 days, which is Monday.

Thus, March 31, 2025 falls on a Monday.

दी गई तारीख 2025-11-02 के लिए सप्ताह का दिन ज्ञात करने के लिए, सबसे पहले 1 जनवरी 2025 का दिन ज्ञात करते हैं।

1 जनवरी 2020 थी बुधवार।
2020 एक लीप वर्ष था, इसलिए 1 जनवरी 2021 को 2 दिन आगे का दिन आया, अर्थात् शुक्रवार।
2021 लीप वर्ष नहीं था, इसलिए 1 जनवरी 2022 शनिवार हुई।
2022 लीप वर्ष नहीं था, इसलिए 1 जनवरी 2023 रविवार हुई।
2023 लीप वर्ष नहीं था, इसलिए 1 जनवरी 2024 सोमवार हुई।
2024 एक लीप वर्ष था, इसलिए 1 जनवरी 2025 को 2 दिन आगे का दिन आया, अर्थात् बुधवार।

इस प्रकार, 1 जनवरी 2025 बुधवार है।

अब 2025 में 1 जनवरी से 2 नवंबर तक कुल कितने दिन हैं, इसका योग करते हैं।
